trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back**: to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt failed partway (us-east rolled back, then halted on an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed in all regions.
3. **Verified**: all three regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate down to 0.2%).
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and the recovery. On-call has been paged.
